title: ADR-005: dataclasses for domain types, Pydantic only at the edges
body:
Writes down what we discussed at Tuesday's arch sync. Pydantic stays at the API boundary (`app/api/schemas.py`) and in config; everything inside services uses frozen dataclasses.

Converts `CustomerView` from #108 as the first example. The remaining Pydantic models in services will move over as we touch them.

Why now: last week's "10.5" coercion bug in the capture path (validation ran in the service model, not at the edge) plus ~15% of request time spent re-validating in the refund path.
author: bob

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+# ADR-005: Dataclasses for domain types, Pydantic only at the edges
+
+- Status: Accepted
+- Date: 2026-02-17
+- Deciders: alice, bob
+
+## Context
+We mix Pydantic models and dataclasses in `app/services/`. Validation runs several times per
+request (API schema -> service model -> repo) and Pydantic v2 coercion silently turned "10.5"
+into a number in one service path.
+
+## Decision
+- Pydantic models live in `app/api/schemas.py` (request/response) and `app/config.py` only.
+- Domain and service types are `@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)` in `app/domain/`.
+- Conversion happens once, in the handler.
+
+## Consequences
+- Services cannot rely on Pydantic validation; validate at the API edge.
+- Supersedes the Pydantic `CustomerView` introduced in #108.

+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CustomerView:
+    id: str
+    email: str
+    country: str
+    lifetime_volume: Decimal
+    open_disputes: int
+
+    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
+        return asdict(self)
